name: nimbus-core
description: Portable Nimbus core: protocol codec, profiles/postures, attention routing, render scheduling, power policy, and the Head-Orchestrator-v2 turn contract (turn parser, two-part memory, journal, device-action classifier). No Arduino dependencies — host-tested via pio test -e native. ArduinoJson is header-only and host-safe (used only by the agent/ contract modules).
